usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all named IP sets defined in a container's firewall configuration. Each returned object includes the set name, an optional human-readable comment, and a digest you can pass to write operations to prevent concurrent modification conflicts. Requires VM.Audit permission on /vms/{vmid}; the container does not need to be running.

examples.summary: List all firewall IP sets for LXC container 200 on node pve1

tips: IP set names follow the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+ and are referenced by name in firewall rules — use this listing to confirm exact names before building rules.
The digest field in each returned item reflects the current state of the firewall config; supply it in subsequent write calls to guard against race conditions.
IP sets defined at the cluster level are separate from container-level sets — this endpoint only returns sets scoped to this specific LXC.
